mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a food borne disease caused by the entrance of bacteria into the body through the ingestion of a contaminated food."
Food infection is a food borne disease caused by the entrance of bacteria into the body through the ingestion of a contaminated food.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a legal requirement that food handlers are supervised and instructed and/or trained in food safety and hygiene matters in accordance with their level of involvement with food."

Training in food safety is a legal requirement that food handlers are supervised and instructed and/or trained in food safety and hygiene matters in accordance with their level of involvement with food.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the processes involved in collecting food samples which will be used for analysis to determine the safety of the food."
Food Sampling for Analysis Food sampling refer to the processes involved in collecting food samples which will be used for analysis to determine the safety of the food.
fib: ______ refer to ―any disease of an infectious or toxic nature resulting from consumption of contaminated food or water‖.
Foodborne diseases (FBDs) refer to ―any disease of an infectious or toxic nature resulting from consumption of contaminated food or water‖.
______ is the ingestion of food containing the microbial toxin while food infection is the ingestion of food contaminated with micro-organisms.
Microbial food poisoning is the ingestion of food containing the microbial toxin while food infection is the ingestion of food contaminated with micro-organisms.
______ is an important food additive that have been used for preservation of foods for thousands of years.
Salt is an important food additive that have been used for preservation of foods for thousands of years.
